strips.title: The couch you thought was clean — a Saturday with the Little Green

panels.head: The dog. The couch. The stain.
panels.text: Vacuum the crumbs first. Fill the tank with warm water and formula.

panels.head: Spray, scrub, pull back slowly
panels.text: The dirty tank turns brown. That's five years of 'clean' cushions.

panels.head: Car seats and the stairs
panels.text: The 15-foot cord reaches the driveway. The hose is short, so move the machine.

panels.head: Rinse the hose, leave tanks open
panels.text: Do that and it never smells. Owners are on year six.
